headline: Zelensky-Rubio clash over early warning
dek: Zelensky: Russia launched 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv region + 200+ drones overnight; Ukraine received 'no early warning' from partners (second such complaint); Russia struck Ukraine energy/oil/gas 76 times since Trump's Oct 11 'energy ceasefire' — Zelensky says he is 'done' with that agreement;…
sources: President Volodymyr Zelensky (social media); US Secretary of State Marco Rubio (remarks to reporters in Uzbekistan)
fault_line: Is Washington quietly downgrading Ukraine's support (sanctions waiver + warning gaps) to force a settlement — or is Zelensky manufacturing the crisis to keep aid flowing?

sections.what_happened: Zelensky: Russia launched 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv region + 200+ drones overnight; Ukraine received 'no early warning' from partners (second such complaint); Russia struck Ukraine energy/oil/gas 76 times since Trump's Oct 11 'energy ceasefire' — Zelensky says he is 'done' with that agreement; overnight Zelensky told NBC intel sharing was deblocked. Rubio denied any pause in intelligence sharing: 'There has been no pause,' telling Zelensky to 'focus' on ending the war.
sections.what_verified: AFP reporters heard air alerts/explosions in Kyiv; TBS: Ukraine launched 1,000+ drones at Russia (St Petersburg oil terminal hit) — reciprocal escalation documented same window.
sections.what_disputed: Rubio explicitly denies the intelligence-sharing pause Zelensky implied; ISW did not report a sharing gap.
sections.why_matters: While Trump negotiates with Moscow and waives sanctions, Kyiv says the warnings stopped coming. The energy ceasefire Trump announced Oct 11 is dead by Zelensky's own count — 76 strikes since. Fault line: is Washington pulling back to force a deal, or is Kyiv crying wolf?
sections.context: Background: US/Ukraine/Russia — UPDATE (extends 0800-01, 1400-01): energy ceasefire collapses; Zelensky-Rubio clash over early warning

totw_analysis: Our read: While Trump negotiates with Moscow and waives sanctions, Kyiv says the warnings stopped coming. The energy ceasefire Trump announced Oct 11 is dead by Zelensky's own count — 76 strikes since. Fault line: is Washington pulling back to force a deal, or is Kyiv crying wolf? The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Washington quietly downgrading Ukraine's support (sanctions waiver + warning gaps) to force a settlement — or is Zelensky manufacturing the crisis to keep aid flowing?
